title: Live heterogeneous smoke test and field report
description: Following ONLY herdr-runner.md + runners-config.md (fresh session, no extra context), run a 2-tick toy epic in a scratch repo from an orchestrator inside herdr: one claude worker + one codex worker, each in its own herdr worktree, results collected via commits + RESULT.md, wave merged, post-wave gate run. Also demonstrate fallback: same config outside a herdr session (or HERDR_ENV unset) routes to harness orchestration with an explicit message. Record a field report (like the existing prime-runner field reports) and fold every doc gap found back into the A1-A4 files as fixes within this tick.
acceptance_criteria: Toy epic completes with two different agent kinds; fallback demonstration recorded; field report committed; all discovered doc gaps fixed
